mapper.insert: insert into CHB_SYS_DEPARTMENT_HIS(DEPT_CODE, HIS_NO, DEPT_NAME, INV_OFFICES, DEPT_FUN, INSTITUTION_CODE, DIRECT_DEPT_CODE, WORKFLOW_ID, REMARK, STATUS, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) select DEPT_CODE, (select IFNULL(max(HIS_NO), 0) from CHB_SYS_DEPARTMENT_HIS where STATUS IN('E','D')) + 1 as HIS_NO, DEPT_NAME, INV_OFFICES, DEPT_FUN, INSTITUTION_CODE, DIRECT_DEPT_CODE, WORKFLOW_ID, REMARK, STATUS, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as UPDATE_USER, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} as UPDATE_TIME from CHB_SYS_DEPARTMENT where STATUS IN('E','D')

insert into CHB_SYS_DEPARTMENT_HIS(DEPT_CODE, HIS_NO, DEPT_NAME, INV_OFFICES, DEPT_FUN, INSTITUTION_CODE, DIRECT_DEPT_CODE, WORKFLOW_ID, REMARK, STATUS, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) select DEPT_CODE, (select IFNULL(max(HIS_NO), 0) from CHB_SYS_DEPARTMENT_HIS where STATUS = 'E') + 1 as HIS_NO, DEPT_NAME, INV_OFFICES, DEPT_FUN, INSTITUTION_CODE, DIRECT_DEPT_CODE, WORKFLOW_ID, REMARK, STATUS, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as UPDATE_USER, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} as UPDATE_TIME from CHB_SYS_DEPARTMENT where STATUS = 'E' and WORKFLOW_ID = #{workflowId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
